policy: Retain discovered defects and original failing reproductions; no post-hoc numerical tolerance tuning

fixes.symptom: Initial harness sent nfft:null rather than omitting the unavailable choice
fixes.fix: Omit null nfft in M1 fixture processing

fixes.symptom: An arbitrary unit-norm supplied filter passed validation while metadata promised finite RRC noise
fixes.fix: Require every supplied filter tap to match the declared normalized finite RRC grid within absolute1e-12, in addition unitnorm check

fixes.symptom: Wrong index formula could report done greater than total for multi-frame synthesis
Valid complex real/imag components1e8 imply power2e16, above old1e16 map validation ceiling
fixes.fix: Raise finite map-input ceiling to1e20; not detector clipping or normalization change

fixes.symptom: Extreme finite external truth/errors overflowed squared error and mean into Infinity
fixes.fix: Bound truth, estimates and errors to declared runtime evaluation domain, reject before arithmetic

fixes.symptom: Non-ASCII provenance text was accepted by observation validation but rejected by ASCII JSON parser
fixes.fix: Restrict admitted provenance model/rng strings to ASCII before export; every supported metadata string now matches portable codec domain

fixes.symptom: Malformed helper results could coerce required null estimates to zero or copy nonfinite resource fields
fixes.fix: Require finite bounded non-null single-frame/range/pooled estimates; only multi-frame can be explicitly null; comparison quantities finite and bounded

nonblocking_limit.note: Arbitrary off-grid scalar RRC values extremely close to the analytic pole can suffer cancellation; actual receiver only evaluates validated2/4/8x grids with exact singular branches
